scenarios.title: Login Items Audit
scenarios.description: Operate a local macOS app instead of a lab page. The agent reads System Settings through the Accessibility API while you keep using your Mac: no browser, and the pointer never moves.
scenarios.defaultPrompt: Open System Settings and tell me which apps are set to open at login (General > Login Items & Extensions). Do not change any settings.
instructions: The task targets local macOS apps, not a lab page. Start with System Settings unless the prompt names another app.
Read only what the prompt asks for. If the prompt says not to change settings, never toggle, type into, or dismiss anything except search fields and navigation.
Finish with a short plain-language summary of what you found.

scenarios.title: Desktop Task
scenarios.description: Give the agent any task on this Mac. It picks the app, opens it in the background, and works through the Accessibility API without taking over your mouse or keyboard.
scenarios.defaultPrompt: Open the Calculator app and compute 1234 * 56. Report the result.
instructions: The task targets local macOS apps, not a lab page. Choose the app that fits the prompt and launch it if needed.
Stay within the apps the task requires and avoid destructive actions: do not delete, send, purchase, or change system-wide settings unless the prompt explicitly asks.
Finish with a short plain-language summary of what you did and the result.
